content.value_statement: HealthTech teams need structured QMR guidance for quality governance and regulatory oversight. This skill provides practical frameworks for ISO 13485, management review, compliance tracking, and quality strategy.
actual_capabilities: Explains QMR responsibility areas for quality system oversight and management accountability.
Provides a framework for monitoring ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA QSR, and other compliance obligations.
Outlines management review topics, quality dashboards, and senior management reporting needs.
Guides quality strategy planning, resource management, KPI tracking, and quality culture initiatives.
Lists intended resource categories for QMR scripts, references, templates, dashboards, and training materials.
limitations: It is guidance content and does not replace qualified regulatory, quality, or legal advice.
The included script, reference, and asset files are placeholders and do not implement production workflows.
It does not verify live compliance status or connect to regulatory authority systems.
Users must adapt all guidance to device class, market, jurisdiction, and company procedures.

use_cases.title: Prepare Management Review Inputs
use_cases.description: Build a structured agenda for quality performance, compliance status, customer feedback, quality costs, and strategic improvement topics.

use_cases.title: Map QMR Responsibilities
use_cases.description: Clarify ownership for quality system oversight, regulatory compliance, reporting, resource planning, and continuous improvement.

use_cases.title: Plan Compliance Governance
use_cases.description: Create a high-level governance plan for ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA QSR, certification maintenance, and compliance risk escalation.

prompt_templates.title: Start a QMR Responsibility Map
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a small HealthTech team.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a QMR responsibility map for a small HealthTech company preparing an ISO 13485 quality system.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Management Review Agenda
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning for recurring leadership reviews.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a quarterly management review agenda with required inputs, owners, decisions, and follow-up actions.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Compliance Governance Gaps
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across multiple regulatory obligations.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to identify governance gaps across ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA QSR, certification maintenance, and authority communication.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Quality Strategy Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for leadership and board alignment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a one-year quality strategy plan with objectives, KPIs, resource needs, risk escalation, and management reporting cadence.

output_examples.input: Create a QMR accountability summary for a new MedTech startup.
output_examples.output: A concise responsibility map covering QMS oversight, regulatory compliance, management reporting, resource planning, and continuous improvement leadership.

output_examples.input: Prepare a quarterly management review outline.
output_examples.output: A leadership-ready agenda with review topics, quality metrics, compliance risks, decision points, owners, and follow-up action categories.

output_examples.input: Define quality KPIs for executive reporting.
output_examples.output: A practical KPI set covering audit results, nonconformity trends, complaints, product quality, compliance outcomes, training completion, and quality costs.

best_practices: Provide company size, device type, target markets, and current QMS maturity before asking for guidance.
Ask for outputs that separate regulatory requirements, business decisions, owners, and evidence records.
Have qualified quality and regulatory leaders review all final procedures before adoption.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated guidance as final regulatory advice or legal interpretation.
Do not ask the skill to confirm compliance without supplying evidence from your quality system.
Do not use placeholder scripts or assets as production tools without implementation and validation.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure QMR responsibilities, quality governance, management review planning, compliance oversight, and quality strategy work.

faq.question: Is this skill specific to medical devices?
faq.answer: Yes. The source guidance focuses on HealthTech and MedTech quality systems, including ISO 13485, EU MDR, and FDA QSR topics.

faq.question: Can it replace a quality manager or regulatory consultant?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning and documentation work, but qualified experts must approve regulated quality and compliance decisions.

faq.question: Does it include working automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The repository includes placeholder script, reference, and asset files. They need implementation before operational use.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: How should teams get the best results?
faq.answer: Share market scope, device class, QMS maturity, audit history, quality objectives, and any known compliance gaps.
